report.explanation: Alert reports degraded checkout health, but current telemetry shows all four services returning status 200 with ok results. The only anomaly is 9 WARN retained_heap_after_gc events in order logs, which alone cannot establish a memory leak or link it to checkout degradation. No latency, error, or resource metrics are available. Insufficient evidence to name a bounded root cause; handing off for more telemetry.
missing_evidence: Order service heap metrics over time (GC frequency, heap used vs max) to confirm or refute a memory leak trend
Latency/error-rate telemetry for checkout path to substantiate the 'degraded' alert
GC pause durations and OOM/restart events for order service
Correlation of retained_heap_after_gc occurrences with request latency or failures
